lines.en: Waving bow, drawing back an arrow.
Draws back bow, locking target.
Quickly moves, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 在遗迹中穿梭，警惕四周。
lines.en: Passes through ruins, vigilant.
Whispers incantations, preparing to fight.

lines.zh: 弓弦拉响，箭矢划破空气。
lines.en: String taut, arrow slicing through air.
Firm steps, intimidating enemies.
Stares at the altar, searching for weaknesses.
Moves slowly, maintaining focus.
Cautiously surveys the area.
Stands like a statue archer.
Reclines against the ruins, gazing.
Eyes wander, seeking targets.
Holds bow, waiting for enemies.
Surveys the surroundings, vigilant.
Meditates on the bow.
Relaxes, listening intently.
Scans the sky, seeking prey.
Tenderly touches the bowstring.
Leans against the wall, lost in thought.

lines.zh: 他把箭尖抵在祭坛上磨。
lines.en: He hones an arrowhead against the altar.

lines.zh: 石像般的躯干纹丝不动。
lines.en: His statue-like body does not stir.

lines.zh: 他数着箭袋里剩下的箭。
lines.en: He counts the arrows left in his quiver.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚的风吹过遗迹。
lines.en: The Appalachia wind crosses the ruins.

lines.zh: 他记着每一支射出的箭。
lines.en: He remembers every arrow he has loosed.

lines.zh: 祭坛的火光映在石甲上。
lines.en: Altar light plays over his stone armor.
Sharp gaze, locking onto player.
Aim at player, ready to shoot.
Nervous of player, closing in.
Staring at player, giving warning.

lines.zh: 祭坛的宝石亮了，弓也拉开了。
lines.en: The altar gem lit, and my bow is drawn.
Approaches player, preparing to fight.
Bowstring taut, waiting for opportunity.
Aiming at player, ready to fire.
Resolute gaze, ready to shoot.
Eyes flash, locking on weak point.

lines.zh: 他确认你站在射程正中。
lines.en: He confirms you stand dead center in range.
The slit in his stone helm narrows.
Tighten the bow, stuck arrow!
Arrow stuck, can't shoot!

lines.zh: 筋疲力尽，我几乎要倒下！
lines.en: Exhausted, I nearly fall!
Rusty bow, can't fight anymore!
Armor damaged, fighting hard!
Wounds too deep, hard to move!
I'm nearly worn out!
So tired, can't fight anymore!
Too exhausted, can't continue!
Serious injury, can't move!

lines.zh: 听到我的弓弦声，你会成为我的猎物。
lines.en: Hear my bowstring, and you become my prey.

lines.zh: 用你的生命之箭填满我的箭袋。
lines.en: Fill my quiver with the arrows of life.

lines.zh: 岩晶之弓在手中，永恒之力掌握。
lines.en: In my hands, the Rock Crystal Bow and eternal power.

lines.zh: 我在这里等你，猎物永远不会失望。
lines.en: I wait here, prey never disappoint.

lines.zh: 你的剑太轻，对付我无用。
lines.en: Your sword is too light, useless against me.

lines.zh: 岩石中诞生，我永恒守护。
lines.en: Born from stone, I eternal guard.

lines.zh: 你的箭无法穿透我的护甲。
lines.en: Your arrows cannot pierce my armor.

lines.zh: 选择我，成为永恒的一部分。
lines.en: Choose me, become part of the eternal.

lines.zh: 用阿帕拉契亚之心唤醒我。
lines.en: Awaken me with the Apalachia Heart.

lines.zh: 我比任何弓箭都更强大。
lines.en: I am stronger than any bow and arrow.

lines.zh: 岩石中传来我的咆哮，让你颤抖。
lines.en: Rumble from the rocks, making you quake.

lines.zh: 我的存在，就是对你的警告。
lines.en: My presence, a warning to you.
Avoid me, or you'll regret it.
Dare you approach the altar?

lines.zh: 用你的生命之箭攻击我？
lines.en: Attack me with your life arrows?

lines.zh: 你无法伤害我，岩石之护甲。
lines.en: You cannot harm me, stone armor.
I will not fall easily.

lines.zh: 你靠近了，离我再近一点。
lines.en: You're close, get closer.
Attack with the Rock Crystal Bow, or.

lines.zh: 我的护甲比你想象的更坚固。
lines.en: My armor is stronger than you think.

lines.zh: 我在这里，等待我的伴侣。
lines.en: I am here, waiting for my mate.

lines.zh: 找到我的同类，共享永恒。
lines.en: Find my同类, share the eternal.

lines.zh: 我的声音召唤我的伴侣。
lines.en: My voice calls my mate.

lines.zh: 我们共同守护这片土地。
lines.en: We protect this land together.

lines.zh: 我的弓箭代表着我的承诺。
lines.en: My bow represents my promise.

lines.zh: 与我并肩，共同面对挑战。
lines.en: Stand by me, face the challenges.

lines.zh: 永恒之力，源自我的爱情。
lines.en: Eternal power, from my love.

lines.zh: 让我们共同走过这片遗迹。
lines.en: Let's walk this ruin together.
My mate, my everything.

lines.zh: 与我一起，体验永恒的爱。
lines.en: Be with me, experience eternal love.

lines.zh: 手中的岩晶之弓闪烁着古朴光芒。
lines.en: The Rock Crystal Bow glows with ancient light in your hands.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚之心，力量之源。
lines.en: The Appalachia Heart, the source of power.
This bow is the eternal choice.
Rock Crystal Bow, my companion.

lines.zh: 永恒射手雕像，注视着我。
lines.en: The Eternal Archer statue gazes upon me.

lines.zh: 岩晶之弓，准备好迎接战斗。
lines.en: Rock Crystal Bow, ready for battle.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚之心，我即将得到。
lines.en: The Appalachia Heart, mine soon.

lines.zh: 岩晶突击者，我的力量源泉。
lines.en: Rock Crystal Striker, my power source.
Eternal Archer, my foe.
This statue represents eternity.
The prey's scent grows stronger.

lines.zh: 祭坛的宝石一亮，我拉开了弓。
lines.en: The altar gem flares; I draw my bow.
The bowstring tightens, the arrow is drawn.
The eternal arrow is about to be released.

lines.zh: 目标就在眼前，一箭毙命。
lines.en: The target is within sight, one arrow to kill.
Rock Crystal Bow, aim and shoot.

lines.zh: 永恒弓箭手的箭矢，无坚不摧。
lines.en: The Eternal Archer's arrows are unbreakable.
Target acquired, eternal arrow.
The arrow whistles, the target is hit.
Eternal Archer, unbreakable.
You have stepped onto the altar's stair.
The gem's light has picked you out.

lines.zh: 他听见你拉动弓弦的声音。
lines.en: He heard you draw a bowstring.

lines.zh: 遗迹里只有你一个活物。
lines.en: You are the only living thing in these ruins.

lines.zh: 他的箭袋已经为你打开。
lines.en: His quiver is already open for you.
You are too close to the altar.

lines.zh: 他数完你的步数，抬弓了。
lines.en: He finishes counting your steps and lifts the bow.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在祭坛中央。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across the altar's center.
My arrows never miss.
Eternal light guides the arrow.
Lock on the prey, one arrow to the heart.
Eternal Archer, precise and accurate.
Aim, shoot, destroy.
My arrows hit the mark.
Eternal Archer, king of precision.
Eternal light pierces through.
Target locked, arrow coming.
Eternal Archer, flawless.
He steps back to take his angle.

lines.zh: 箭尖对着你的胸口不动。
lines.en: The arrowhead holds steady on your chest.
He draws the bow to its fullest arc.
His stone armor turns, seams aimed at you.

lines.zh: 他算好了你侧身的余地。
lines.en: He has already allowed for your dodge.
The wind dies. He is about to loose.

lines.zh: 他踩着祭坛边沿找角度。
lines.en: He works the altar's rim for a clear line.
A second arrow is already nocked.
He waits for you to move first.
The bow hums with stored tension.

lines.zh: 挥舞长弓，箭矢划破长空！
lines.en: Swing the longbow, arrows slicing the sky!
Arrows rain down, piercing all!
Load and shoot, target weak spots!
My arrows never miss!
Target and shoot, double pierce!
Bowstring vibrates, power converges!

lines.zh: 猎物何足挂齿，一箭毙命！
lines.en: Game not worth a bullet, one arrow kills!
Arrows scream, precise guidance!
Arrows like wind, penetrate all!

lines.zh: 猎物别想逃脱，箭矢封喉！
lines.en: Game has no chance, arrow to the throat!
This arrow was measured to your distance!
On this altar, no arrow misses!
I use your heartbeat as the target!
Stone armor turns your blade!

lines.zh: 弓箭手的召唤仪式开始了！
lines.en: Eternal Archer's summoning ritual begins!

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚之心跳动着力量！
lines.en: The Appalachia Heart beats with power!
Relic altar, summon the eternal!

lines.zh: 献上阿帕拉契亚宝石，唤醒我！
lines.en: Offer the Appalachia gem, awaken me!

lines.zh: 我的雕像，见证永恒之战！
lines.en: My statue, witness eternal war!

lines.zh: 岩晶之弓，我的得力助手！
lines.en: Rock Crystal Bow, my trusty aid!
Rock Crystal Assaulters, your opponents!
Offer sacrifices, summon me!
Eternal Archer, about to arrive!
My existence, cannot be ignored!
The gem seats, and I open my eyes.
The altar shakes and eternity wakes.

lines.zh: 多少年了，终于有人献上宝石。
lines.en: After so many years, someone brings a gem.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚的守卫归位。
lines.en: Appalachia's warden takes his post.

lines.zh: 我在这座祭坛上站了千年。
lines.en: I have stood at this altar a thousand years.
You have woken my statue.
The stone remembers every arrow of mine.
The offering is made. The trial begins.
The bow is in hand. Your way back is closed.

lines.zh: 让我看看你配不配这颗心。
lines.en: Let us see if you deserve this heart.
Flame licks across my stone armor.

lines.zh: 我从祭坛边缘跌了下来。
lines.en: I dropped from the altar's edge.
Water pours into the seams of my armor.
The blast cracked my bow's limb.
Your arrow found a seam in me.
A spell burns through my stone armor.
The altar's offerings ran out long ago.
Lightning struck my bow.
Even an eternal archer can fall.
